newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Investment parent to inject assets - paper.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Investment parent to inject assets - paper.

text.p: Guangdong Investment Ltd's parent Guangdong Enterprises Ltd is expected to inject another HK$1.2 billion in property assets into the company, the Hong Kong Economic Journal reported on Thursday.
Quoting market sources, it said Guangdong Enterprises would sell a newly completed office tower at 147 Connaught Road Central to Guangdong Investment at an average price of about HK$6,700 per sq ft.
Guangdong Investment officials were not available for comment.
Its shares were unchanged at HK$5.40 in late morning.
Guangdong Enterprises, an arm of the government of China's Guangdong province, holds 37.88 percent of Guangdong Investment.
